items.title: Eddie Palmieri — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My father, Carlos Manuel Palmieri. They were both born in Ponce, Puerto Rico.

ctx.x: Before we get to that, can we talk about your parents’ full names, and where they originally came from.

Oh, of course. My mother was Isabel Maldonado... Well, they called it Isabel Palmieri Maldonado; they gave the second name, the maiden name last. My father, Carlos Manuel Palmieri. They were both born in Ponce, Puerto Rico.
Now, the last name, Palmieri, is that of Corsican origin?
